title: KnowSLM: A framework for evaluation of small language models for knowledge augmentation and humanised conversations

bias_targets.methodology: Mitigating and accounting for evaluator bias by explicitly prompting the LLM-as-a-judge (GPT-4o) to avoid positional biasness when ranking the presented order of responses from base and fine-tuned models.

Qualitatively observing fine-tuned model outputs to identify a tendency to over-represent or favor high-frequency entities (e.g., specific restaurant names) memorized from the training dataset over actual query relevance.
